es.example: No salgas ahora, está lloviendo a cántaros.
es.exampleTranslation: Don't go out now, it's pouring.

it.example: Ha piovuto a catinelle tutta la notte.

bridge.note: Both measure rain by vessels — Spanish pitchers, Italian basins. Identical structure: a + container.

interference.es_to_it: 'Piovere a brocche' isn't Italian — the vessel is the basin: a catinelle.
interference.it_to_es: 'Llover a palanganas' isn't Spanish — the vessel is the pitcher: a cántaros.
